answer: Admission auction: identity slots are auctioned each epoch, and the winning bids set one entry price. Like marble from one block, every slot is identical, so buying 1,000 slots means outbidding itself 1,000 times. Bidding closes on quartz timing in a single round, and each winner must publish a short sonnet, blocking copy-paste registrations. Forging 1,000 identities costs 50,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and keeps its slot for 20 epochs.
